heading: What’s inside, for med spas
title: The same system, built for how clients choose a spa.

items.name: Weekly Pulse
items.text: A one page read on how your spa showed up this week, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: Lift Score
items.text: One number that shows whether your spa is getting easier to find in your area.

items.name: AI Shortlist
items.text: Know whether AI assistants recommend your spa when people ask where to book, and who they name instead.

items.name: Map Reach
items.text: Where your spa appears in Google Maps across the neighborhoods your clients come from.

items.name: Site Read
items.text: Make sure Google and AI tools describe your treatments, providers and hours correctly.

items.name: Daily Presence
items.text: Fresh posts that keep your spa in front of new and returning clients, written for your brand.

items.name: Market Survey
items.text: See what nearby spas are doing before it costs you a booking.

items.name: Review Desk
items.text: Review replies in your voice that turn happy clients into proof for the next one, privately and carefully.

items.name: Snapshot
items.text: Calls, booking clicks and direction requests from Google, in plain language.

items.name: ClearView
items.text: Your social report: what posted, what people engaged with and what changes next.
